summary: The recorded base writes padded flat-kernel lanes past rope_dim. The exact candidate prevents padded x/frequency accesses and stores; its regression and independent adversarial GPU cases pass.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression on recorded base: 5 failed, 10 passed; non-power-of-two numerical and sentinel-overwrite failures.
Exact candidate regression: 15 passed on gfx950.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-44682f8df6bb/venv/bin/python - (independent adversarial script; see raw/adversarial.log)
tests.what_was_measured: 120 independent PyTorch-reference cases across rank, width, dtype, positions, and inverse mode, plus five strided sentinel boundary cases.

gpu_execution.evidence: Real Triton kernels ran on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-; logs record base corruption and candidate passes.

remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA B200 was available, so the reported compute-sanitizer trace was not reproduced.
The exact contiguous rope_dim=6 wrong-value race did not manifest on gfx950, although deterministic out-of-contract writes did.
No full-model, serving, or distributed workload was run; the affected path is opt-in and the review is kernel-level.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python/Triton and the prepared environment records no native component.
